name: Cosmic Pilot VR
summary:
This game is designed for players with cerebral palsy. 


Defend Earth from flying meteors and aliens!

Collect enough floating globs of gasoline and fly your spaceship into outer space. When in space use the robotic arms on the spaceship to crush the incoming meteors. Sooner or later you will encounter hostile alien spaceships, that you will have to destroy in order to stay alive and keep Earth safe.
